title: Americans opposed to a data center near them
description: Share of US respondents who would oppose a data center being built near where they live. One pollster has asked the same question repeatedly since the summer of 2025; two others have asked once.
notes: Embold Research, polling for Heatmap Pro, has asked registered voters 'Would you support or oppose a data center being built near where you live?' five times since August 2025, by text-to-web, with the wording unchanged. The share in favour fell from 44% to 21% over the first three waves; Heatmap did not publish it for the last two. Heatmap Pro is a paid product, so only the headline figures in Heatmap's articles are recorded here, and the February 2026 fieldwork dates were not published. The hollow circles are other pollsters' single readings, each with its own wording and sample: Gallup asked 1,000 adults by telephone whether they would oppose an AI data center in their area, and Reuters/Ipsos asked 4,531 people about one in their community. Points sit at the middle of each poll's fieldwork, and every figure's citation is in manual/us-data-center-opinion.csv.
